name: utils-mcp
description: Read DESCO prepaid accounts and NESCO recharge history and monthly usage.
long_description: Connects the DESCO prepaid electricity portal (Bangladesh) to Claude. Ask for your linked accounts, your current balance, or the realtime reading status. The extension runs on your own computer and sends your login only to the DESCO portal over HTTPS. Unofficial and not affiliated with DESCO. NESCO prepaid history is also available in beta using an authorized customer or meter number; successful account responses are unverified.

desco_username.title: DESCO username
desco_username.description: The username you use to sign in to the DESCO prepaid portal.

desco_password.title: DESCO password
desco_password.description: Stored in your computer's secure keychain, never in a plain file.

nesco_meter_id.title: NESCO customer or meter number
nesco_meter_id.description: Optional authorized 8–11 digit number. NESCO support is beta.

tools.name: desco_list_accounts
tools.description: List your linked DESCO prepaid accounts

tools.name: desco_get_balance
tools.description: Get the prepaid balance for an account

tools.name: nesco_get_meter_status
tools.description: Get the prepaid balance and meter state for an authorized meter (beta)
